summary: Novenas feature (iter 61) tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (100%) — list returns all 11 novenas, detail localized + carries day_intentions for Divine Mercy & St Michael, start/complete-day/active/stop work, 409 conflict returns detail.active_slug, restart-same-slug replaces enrollment, 400 on invalid start_date and day, AI reflection generates and is cached per (slug,day) and localized. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Prayer hub → 'Novenas' card navigates to /novenas (11 cards render). Detail shows patron, feast, intro, prayer. Start flow with quick chips + YYYY-MM-DD input + Start Novena button enrolls. After start, screen shows 'Day 1 of 9', 9 day-dots (8 locked with lock icon), day intention for Divine Mercy, PRAYER, AI CONTEMPLATION (loads in ~5s). Mark Day Complete → dot becomes checkmark, '1 completed' shown. Restart/Stop visible. Active banner appears on list with 'IN PROGRESS' badge and routes to detail. Spanish localization (lang=es) translates novena names, intros, themes, day intentions, feast labels and the 'IN PROGRESS' banner (→ 'EN CURSO'). One minor i18n gap: dynamic template strings 'X of Y days complete' and 'Day X of 9' / 'X completed' remain in English in ES (AutoText does not translate template-with-interpolation phrases).

issues: Dynamic progress labels are not localized in ES/IT: 'X of Y days complete' (active banner) and 'Day X of 9', 'X completed' (detail) remain English when lang=es. Likely because AutoText can't extract literal portions from template-interpolated children. Consider passing the localized phrase via i18n with placeholders (e.g., t('day_of_total', {n, total})).

action_items: (Polish, low priority) Localize the dynamic progress strings 'Day X of 9', 'X completed', and 'X of Y days complete' in /app/frontend/app/novenas/[slug].tsx and /app/frontend/app/novenas/index.tsx by routing through the i18n keys (t('novena.day_of_total'), t('novena.completed_count')) instead of wrapping interpolated template literals in AutoText.
critical_code_review_comments: novenas.py:208 broad except swallows translation failures silently — fine for graceful EN fallback but consider logging the exception for ops visibility.

novenas.py:347 — if reflection LLM fails, response returns reflection:'' (200). Frontend handles this with a spinner that never resolves until day reselect. Consider returning a non-empty placeholder or surfacing a retry signal.
